title: Patriots rookie Gabe Jacas: What happened in the past doesn't matter, I'm 100 percent now

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots rookie Gabe Jacas: What happened in the past doesn't matter, I'm 100 percent now
sources.description: Patriots second-round pick Gabe Jacas was the final member of the 2025 draft class to sign an NFL contract, but the linebacker wasn't interested in discussing the reason why it took until camp was underway for that deal to get done.
